Election Information
Residents can register to vote at the Town Clerk's Office during normal business hours.  You can also register to vote online at www.mass.gov or at any Registry of Motor Vehicles Office or other State Agency.
To be eligible to vote at an election or Town Meeting, you must be registered to vote at least ten (10) days prior.  The Town Clerk's Office will remain open until 5:00pm on this deadline to accommodate voters wishing to register.
Mail-in Voter Registration forms are available at the Norwell Post Office, the Norwell Public Library, and at Norwell Town Hall in the Town Clerk's Office.  Please call the Town Clerk's Office at 781-659-8072 with any questions.
Qualifications for Voting
A voter must meet the following qualifications to vote in the municipality:
Must be a U. S. citizen;
Must be a Norwell resident; and
Must be at least 18 years old on or before the next election.
